scope: Installation, feature, resource and cancellation measurement; not A04 frozen science settings or a public atomistic runtime

initial_hard_limits.output_storage_policy: Engine /work uses a hard 256MiB tmpfs, copied to controlled scratch only after completion; /tmp uses a separate hard128MiB tmpfs. Both count against cgroup memory.

OCI_preflight.concurrent_new_production_job_policy: Stop isolated probe and report no-go if a queued/running production job is observed

go_no_go.native_probe_go: Both actual native digest pulls, binary feature/data/units checks, bounded successful calculations, real active-engine cancellation/cleanup/followup and independent web probes pass
go_no_go.OCI_isolated_probe_go: Fixed verified controller preflight, measured web responsiveness under actual probe, no production changes/jobs and declared headroom hold
go_no_go.public_atomistic_enablement: no-go: no runtime contract/adapter, no per-account atomic quotas and no physical acceptance yet
go_no_go.A04_dependency: Review actual binary/source identity and density diagnostics; freeze explicit numerics/conversions before scientific acceptance
